text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... "I'm always rooting for you!"
And, "You
look so cool on the track!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wowie zowie, you've got so much fan
mail, Ryan.
You're as popular as ever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Me? Popular? It doesn't really feel like
that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm happy to get fan mail. Reading
everyone's
nice words really gets me
pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It sure does. Every single letter is
precious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Okay, on to the next one...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Dearest Mejiro Ryan. Ever since seeing
you run,
the pounding of my heart has
been ceaseless."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, it sounds like a love letter! How
bold! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, someone as popular as you must
get letters
like this every day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: N-no... That's not what this is!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But...
that's the impression I get from the
younger
girls sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Those are just friendly relations between
older
and younger students—emphasis
on friendly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! This isn't a l-l-l-love letter or
anything
like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uhh, I'm gonna go for a run!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aw, she's gone... But I'm sure everyone's

expressing how they really feel in these.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she's too embarrassed to read
through
them all, every single fan letter
gives Mejiro Ryan
more motivation.
